use_cases.name: Complete Onboarding Checklist
use_cases.description: New employee views and tracks all required onboarding tasks with due dates

use_cases.name: Submit Required Documents
use_cases.description: New employee uploads and e-signs I-9, W-4, and direct deposit forms

use_cases.name: Review Team Introduction
use_cases.description: New employee views team member profiles with photos and roles

use_cases.name: Provision IT Accounts
use_cases.description: System automatically creates email, Slack, and SaaS tool accounts via Azure AD integration

use_cases.name: Monitor Onboarding Progress
use_cases.description: HR administrator views dashboard of new hire completion status and outstanding tasks

use_cases.name: Collect Employee Data
use_cases.description: System retrieves new employee information from Workday to pre-populate portal

use_cases.name: Authenticate User
use_cases.description: User logs in via Azure AD SSO

use_cases.name: Generate Audit Logs
use_cases.description: System records all document submissions and account provisioning actions for SOC 2 compliance
